name: app-frosted-glass-onboarding-cards-with-3d-coins-and-arrows
title: Frosted Onboarding Cards with 3D Coins
whatItIs: A pastel iridescent field with tall frosted glass cards in a horizontal carousel, two centre cards showing a paper plane with silver coins under 'No loan offer is available right now.' and circular arrows around a bitcoin under 'Smart money insights', each with a white Let's go pill.
whatItMeans: Glass cards over a soft holographic gradient feel modern and gentle, and small 3D objects illustrate ideas without clutter.
techniques: Tall frosted glass cards on an iridescent backdrop
3D objects (coins, arrows, paper plane) as illustrations
White pill buttons at each card base
Cropped side cards implying a carousel

vocabulary.definition: A translucent blurred card over a colourful backdrop.
A horizontal row of cards with the neighbours cropped.
A small rendered object used as an illustration.
